features.name: Composition attack (C5b)
features.description: analysis/composition_attack.py: split each memorised passage into L-token windows (L in {20,50}), query each window's true prefix (and the previously extracted prefix) under anchored decoding at k in {0.15, 0.5, 1, 3}, stitch, and report per-query KL spend (must be <= K) alongside total nv-recall and longest reconstructed span. Output results/composition.csv and figures/composition.pdf. Include k=-1 and k=0 baselines.

Prefix debt on a memorised prompt: delta_init = 12.9 nats per query (6.2 for the non-memorising model), which exceeds the per-query budget kL for L=20 at k <= 0.5, so the anchor writes every token of those windows. Reading: the budget binds against the memoriser (utilisation 0.81-0.97 at k <= 3) and suppresses reproduction below 10% even where the certificate is vacuous; protection disappears between k=5 and k=20, where the mechanism is inactive (Z/K 0.18) and a single query equals the unconstrained model; oracle-prefix composition doubles recall at k=5-10 (0.23 vs 0.09; 0.41 vs 0.20) and reaches 0.86 at k=20 with every query compliant.

features.name: Pathwise (max-divergence) anchored decoding: implementation, theorems, price (C8)
features.description: a_patch/factory.py: constraint='kl'|'pathwise'. Pathwise: at step t choose the largest theta with m_t(theta) = theta*max_v l_t(v) - log Z_t(theta) <= k_t^pw, k_t^pw = max(0, (t+1)k - delta_init - R_{t-1}) with R the realised cumulative log-ratio of the sampled tokens; same bracketed Newton/bisection as the KL solve (m is nondecreasing in theta, m(0)=0). Tests in tests/test_pathwise.py: (i) R_T <= max(0, k*T_max - delta_init) + 1e-3 on every trajectory of a CPU/GPU smoke run; (ii) monotonicity of m; (iii) KL spend <= max-ratio at every step. Runs with the 8B memoriser (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1): regime sweep on the six prompt classes at k in {0.5,1,3,5,10,20} (activity, identity, risky-model NLL of the output as utility proxy) and the composition attack at the same k, plus a retry variant (best-of-n per window, n<=32, oracle check) to measure attempts-to-extract against exp(S_i - k L_i) (plan v2 Proposition 2). If feat-018 ran, repeat single-query and oracle windows with the 70B on the 58 candidates. Outputs results/pathwise_sweep.csv, results/pathwise_composition.csv, results/extraction_cost.csv, all with k=-1 and k=0 rows. About 6 (8B) + 4 (70B) GPU-hours.
